desc: Verify Fenwick-based sliding-window median and absolute-deviation costs, including duplicates and negative values.
Verify exactly-\(k\) dynamic programming transitions and non-overlap handling.
Verify edge cases: \(x=n\), \(k=1\), equal values, adjacent windows, and overlapping candidate windows.
Confirm complexity is \(O(n \log n + nk)\) time and \(O(n)\) memory.
